title: Your {{appName}} quotes in a few clicks
subtitle: XPEL PPF paint protection, ceramic coating, tinted windows: build, finance and issue premium quotes for your customers in a single journey.

features.title: Attention to detail, right down to your quotes
features.subtitle: Everything you need to issue an accurate, professional quote, with no re-typing.
features.item1: A quote in a few clicks
features.item1Desc: Vehicle, services, financing, customer: a guided five-step journey with a print-ready summary.
features.item2Desc: Prices come from the PERFORM'CAR catalog and stay frozen on every issued quote.
features.item3Desc: Cash, credit, lease with purchase option or long-term lease: the monthly payment is calculated automatically.
features.item4Desc: Find your quotes and customers, follow their status and your conversion rate from the dashboard.

showcase.title: PERFORM'CAR expertise
showcase.subtitle: The services you can offer your customers, from protection film to performance.
showcase.card1Desc: Invisible paint protection against stone chips and scratches, installed by an XPEL certified center.
showcase.card2Desc: The same protection with a satin finish, transforming the look of a gloss paint.
showcase.card3Desc: Change your vehicle's color while protecting it, with 16 exclusive colors.
showcase.card4Desc: From the Front Pack to the Full Pack, protection suited to every use and budget.
showcase.card5Desc: Long-lasting gloss and easier care, applied by a SYSTEMX accredited center.
showcase.card6Desc: Thermal comfort, privacy and UV protection.
showcase.card7Desc: A dedicated windshield film to limit impacts and chips.
showcase.card8Desc: Engine remapping and parts from our partners: Armytrix, Akrapovic, KW.

steps.title: Three steps to a quote
steps.step1Desc: Pick the brand, model, version and color from the catalog.
steps.step2Desc: Select the services, then the financing: total and monthly payment are calculated for you.
steps.step3Desc: Save it, print it and follow its status through to completion.
